payload.label: an isolated container that runs only while working
payload.billing: per 10 ms while running; sleeps to zero between calls

dockerfile_lines: RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ffmpeg fonts-dejavu-core fonts-ebgaramond chromium fonts-inter fonts-noto-color-emoji && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir onnxruntime==1.23.2 tokenizers==0.22.1 numpy==2.3.3 blake3==1.0.5

RUN mkdir -p /opt/models/campplus-voice && cd /opt/models/campplus-voice && python -c "import urllib.request as u, blake3 as b; p='campplus_cn_en_common_200k.onnx'; u.urlretrieve('https://huggingface.co/welcomyou/campplus-3dspeaker-200k-onnx/resolve/6265ff7af2a104d745b4389026ed9815c6c1c6ff/'+p,p); assert b.blake3(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest() == 'da1c3e7a3fdf95635f967c4c79e1c0d7e922e5c5eb598f06d39d1b600cbc6f42'"

RUN mkdir -p /opt/models/clip-vit-base-patch32 && cd /opt/models/clip-vit-base-patch32 && python -c "import json, urllib.request as u, blake3 as b; B='https://huggingface.co/Xenova/clip-vit-base-patch32/resolve/d15189d7028b43f1d3e65039190477f6af591c2a/'; W={'onnx/text_model.onnx': '4a2656f646824b8ae4e3ddf16c4761a208379a600cfb72a03673c2dd88feeb71', 'tokenizer.json': 'fce83ce4401d6659642c31e4d7f78b926b83e5f8f091be7f827c32f580d44712'}; [u.urlretrieve(B + p, p.split('/')[-1]) for p in W]; bad = [p for p, h in W.items() if b.blake3(open(p.split('/')[-1], 'rb').read()).hexdigest() != h]; assert not bad, bad; json.dump({'names': {'name': 'ViT-B-32', 'pretrained': 'openai'}, 'context_length': 77, 'pad_id': 49407}, open('model.json', 'w'))"

RUN mkdir -p /opt/models/u2net-human-seg && cd /opt/models/u2net-human-seg && python -c "import urllib.request as u, blake3 as b; p='u2net_human_seg.onnx'; u.urlretrieve('https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg/releases/download/v0.0.0/'+p,p); assert b.blake3(open(p,'rb').read()).hexdigest() == '71a0354b1cfafe7241c9d46b08cea3af8904818f8ac4c649317e24945f4bbb83'"

RUN mkdir -p /opt/models/faces && cd /opt/models/faces && python -c "import urllib.request as u, blake3 as b; B='https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/opencv/opencv_zoo/'; W={'f12e12798e8314f7c074a6656816c048dcc95b7a/models/face_detection_yunet/face_detection_yunet_2023mar.onnx': '3d5938c4cd5a02dc416f1cd1f7fc1f662a22adc370477112c871954587e63431', 'ba91a3b91d00d76e86540d4013f944bd6b514e39/models/face_recognition_sface/face_recognition_sface_2021dec.onnx': '584d0f5792e9e776ab5e5bf3f559f2310ff8fdd3b39f94dd364751046592b512'}; [u.urlretrieve(B + p, p.split('/')[-1]) for p in W]; bad = [p for p, h in W.items() if b.blake3(open(p.split('/')[-1], 'rb').read()).hexdigest() != h]; assert not bad, bad"

RUN printf '%s' '<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "fonts.dtd"><fontconfig><alias binding="same"><family>SF Pro Text</family><prefer><family>Inter</family></prefer></alias><alias binding="same"><family>SF Pro Display</family><prefer><family>Inter</family></prefer></alias></fontconfig>' > /etc/fonts/local.conf
